actual_decision.public_rationale: Two measured interventions have reduced tile overhead. gelu002 adds mode-targeted gains with20/20 standalone/prepared correctness and successful runtime. Remaining exact case20 vector ratio0.851725 limits the evidence for further overhead work; tanh case8/14 vector ratios0.619331/0.747766 still leave possible opportunity, but pipe ratios do not establish overlap loss or actionable API redundancy. Larger FP32 tanh tile16384 would require327680 explicit bytes, above196608UB; simply duplicating8192 input/output buffers needs229376bytes. A next intervention therefore requires a new lifetime/schedule or numerical/API argument not established by current evidence. Freeze both actual candidates for full-case evaluation rather than extend the source search without a sufficiently supported mechanism. This is not a claim of optimality.
actual_decision.reason_for_not_using_remaining_round: No sufficiently discriminated next intervention; not budget exhaustion or a globalAAfailure stop.

actual_decision.public_rationale: Two measured interventions have reduced tile overhead. gelu002 adds mode-targeted gains with20/20 standalone/prepared correctness and successful runtime. Remaining exact case20 vector ratio0.851725 limits the evidence for further overhead work; tanh case8/14 vector ratios0.619331/0.747766 still leave possible opportunity, but pipe ratios do not establish overlap loss or actionable API redundancy. Larger FP32 tanh tile16384 would require327680 explicit bytes, above196608UB; simply duplicating8192 input/output buffers needs229376bytes. A next intervention therefore requires a new lifetime/schedule or numerical/API argument not established by current evidence. Freeze both actual candidates for full-case evaluation rather than extend the source search without a sufficiently supported mechanism. This is not a claim of optimality.
actual_decision.reason_for_not_using_remaining_round: No sufficiently discriminated next intervention; not budget exhaustion or a globalAAfailure stop.
